svg.aria-label: Beamtime software architecture: actors (user, coding agent, experiment script) use the web UI, CLI, MCP server and SDK; all frontends call one operation set, which uses queries, the research record and views over a SQLite and column-file index cache built from plain run directories; remote clusters answer the same API over ssh.
svg.title: Beamtime software architecture
svg.text: What each part is, which module and class creates it, and how they connect: runs are plain files, the index is a cache, every frontend calls one operation set.
Reads runs and verdicts in the web UI; edits texts as new versions.
Runs the user-only commands: init, serve, settings, mv, rm.
Learns the defaults from beamtime guide; uses the CLI or the MCP tools.
Writes are additive (proposals, notes, views, blocks, memory); never user-only ops.
a simulation, a training loop, a scan; anywhere
listed under remotes: in the settings
the remote is the truth; data flows to you

shell/app.ts App: group tree, pages, drawer, palette

bt/writes.ts: edited texts are saved as new versions
bt/export.ts: PNG, SVG, or a PDF from /api/figure

views.py · blocks.py new, validate, render, save, export

answer(): the entry for CLI and MCP
a serve holds the ssh → via_serve.call()
